title: Recover ownership without trusting stale client state
description: Choose a coordination pattern, inject a connection or session event, and decide how the client should recover. The server state, not the local cache, determines ownership.

patterns.label: Service membership
patterns.detail: An ephemeral znode advertises a live endpoint.
patterns.expiredEffect: The endpoint disappears from discovery after the session expires.
patterns.burstEffect: Consumers may see one watch notification for several membership changes.

patterns.label: Leader ownership
patterns.detail: An ephemeral sequential candidate establishes ordering.
patterns.expiredEffect: The candidate znode is deleted and another participant can become leader.
patterns.burstEffect: Several candidate changes can occur before a disconnected client rereads the queue.

patterns.label: Configuration cache
patterns.detail: A watch invalidates a locally cached configuration value.
patterns.expiredEffect: The old watch belongs to the expired session and cannot protect the cache.
patterns.burstEffect: Multiple writes can collapse into one notification; the client must fetch the latest version.

events.label: Brief disconnect
events.detail: Connectivity returns before the negotiated session timeout.

events.label: Session expires
events.detail: The ensemble has not heard from the client before the timeout.

events.label: Rapid state changes
events.detail: Several writes occur before the client handles its watch event.
events.watchState: A watch is not an event log

responses.label: Continue from local state
responses.detail: Keep serving from the cached value or ownership claim.
responses.action: No server read or ownership check is performed.

responses.label: Reread and re-arm
responses.detail: Fetch the current znode and install the next watch as one recovery step.
responses.action: The client rebuilds its view from the ensemble's latest version.

responses.label: Create a new session and fence
responses.detail: Re-register ephemeral state and obtain a newer fencing token before external work.
responses.action: A stale owner cannot continue writing after replacement.
